programmes.d: After the death of her husband, a woman (Oscar winner Susan Sarandon) moves from New Jersey to Los Angeles to be closer to her daughter (Rose Byrne).
Bill Nighy stars as a humorless bureaucrat in 1950s London who decides to take time off work to experience life following a grim diagnosis.

This anthology explores the faces of love in a romantic Parisian setting. Directors include the Coen brothers, Alfonso Cuaron, Olivier Assayas, Wes Craven and more. Starring Juliette Binoche, Emily Mortimer, Steve Buscemi, Natalie Portman and more.
